summary: ZCode Global Build Round 4 is live — GLM-5.3-Flash is free in ZCode from Sep 3 through Sep 20 (extended from Sep 18 per ZCode's official reply), 10 hours/day inside the window 11 PM Beijing / 8 AM PT. Coding Plan members get it automatically every day inside the window; new users get 100M free tokens on sign-up (one-time, valid until the window closes). This is a recurring promotional event: Round 1 (Aug 16, paused after ~1 hour), Round 2 (Aug 21-23), Round 3 (Sep 3, 1 day).
claim_steps: Be a new ZCode user without an active paid coding plan.
Log into the ZCode desktop app during the promotional window (11 PM Beijing / 8 AM PT, 10 hrs/day).
Tap the card in the bottom-left corner to claim. The card is only for new sign-ups — Coding Plan members are free automatically inside the window (check Settings -> Usage stats).
If the card is not visible, restart the app.
Use the tokens inside ZCode before Sep 20; unused tokens expire.
